html:
[Hypothesis]

  • \(\omega\)（自然数集，见 ../batch16/58-df-omega.md）

  • \(\Sigma_{\mathrm{cnst}},\Sigma_{\mathrm{fn}},\Sigma_{\mathrm{rel}}\in V\)（两两不交的符号集）

  • \(a_{\mathrm{fn}}:\Sigma_{\mathrm{fn}}\to\omega\) 与 \(a_{\mathrm{rel}}:\Sigma_{\mathrm{rel}}\to\omega\)（元数映射）

  • \(\Sigma\coloneqq(\Sigma_{\mathrm{cnst}},\Sigma_{\mathrm{fn}},a_{\mathrm{fn}},\Sigma_{\mathrm{rel}},a_{\mathrm{rel}})\)

  • \(\mathrm{Var}_S\coloneqq\{v_k:k\in\omega\}\)，并与所有非逻辑符号不交

  • \(\mathrm{Trm}_k(\Sigma)\subseteq V\)（深度至多 \(k\) 的项）

  • \(\mathrm{Trm}_S(\Sigma)\subseteq V\)（全部项）

  • \(\mathrm{AtFml}_S(\Sigma)\subseteq V\)（原子公式）

  • \(\mathrm{Fml}_k(\Sigma)\subseteq V\)（深度至多 \(k\) 的公式）

  • \(\mathrm{Fml}_S(\Sigma)\subseteq V\)（全部一阶公式）

  • 所有语法构造子均采用互不相撞的集合编码

  • \(L\) 为 \(\mathrm{FirstOrderLanguage}_S(L)\) 所约束的四分量语言编码；\(\mathrm{FormulaSignatureOf}_S(L)\) 为下式的五分量签名。

  • 原五分量签名上的递归保持不变；四分量输入通过下式调用同一语法递归。

[Assertion]

[Remark]

  • 签名显式记录常量、函数/关系符号及其元数；也可把常量视为零元函数。
  • 项层级和公式层级均由等式递归定义，因而不会包含仅满足闭包条件的额外“垃圾语法”。
  • 原子公式包括等式与关系原子；\(\neg,\lor,\forall\) 是功能完备的基本逻辑构造子。
  • 每层包含前一层，所以层级按深度递增。
  • \(\mathrm{Fml}_S(\Sigma)=\bigcup_{k\in\omega}\mathrm{Fml}_k(\Sigma)\) 给出全部有限深度良构公式。

backlinks.excerpt: $\mathrm{Fml}_S(\Sigma)$ and $\mathrm{Trm}_S(\Sigma)$ (formula and term sets generated by the same signature; see [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]])
$\Sigma$ 是一阶签名，其函数符号集与函数元数映射分别记作 $\Sigma_{\mathrm{fn}}$ 与 $a_{\mathrm{fn}}$（see [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]]）
$\mathcal L_{\in}$ 是规范的纯隶属语言编码，$\varphi\in\mathrm{Fml}_S(\mathcal L_{\in})$（see [[../batch06/58-df-proper.md]] and [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]]）

$\mathcal L_\in$、$\mathrm{Var}_S$、$\mathrm{Trm}_S(\mathcal L_\in)$、$\mathrm{Fml}_S(\mathcal L_\in)$ 使用 [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]]；$\mathsf F=\mathrm{Fml}_S(\mathcal L_\in)$、$\mathsf V=\mathrm{Var}_S$。
$\mathrm{Fml}_S(\Sigma)$ (formula set for the explicit signature, see [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]])
$\Sigma\in V$, with $\mathrm{RelSym},\mathrm{RelAr},\mathrm{Fml}_S,\mathrm{Trm}_S:V\to V$ (the relation-symbol and arity projections of the signature contract in [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]])
外部接口 $\mathrm{Trm}$ 取 [[58-df-formula]] 的同名定义与参数次序。
$\mathrm{Trm}_S(\Sigma)$ and $\mathrm{AtFml}_S(\Sigma)$ are the term and atomic-formula code sets from [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]].
$\mathrm{Fml}_S(\mathcal L)$ (语言 $\mathcal L$ 的公式集, see [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]])
$\mathrm{Fml}_S(\mathcal L)$ and $\operatorname{FV}_{\mathcal L}$ (公式集与自由变元算子, see [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]], [[../batch07/58-df-free-variable.md]])
The clauses cover equality atoms, relation atoms, negation, disjunction, and universal quantification—the complete constructor basis used by [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]].

Signatures use the syntax tuple
$L=\langle C,F,a_F,R,a_R\rangle$ from [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]].

$\mathrm{Ordinal}$, $\mathrm{Fml}_S(\{\in\})$, and $\models$ are the ordinal, formula, and satisfaction notions (see [[../batch17/58-df-ordinal.md]], [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]], [[../batch18/58-df-satisfaction.md]])
$\mathrm{Fml}_S(L)$ and $\operatorname{FV}_L$ (formula set and free-variable operator, see [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]] and [[../batch07/58-df-free-variable.md]])

$\varphi_{\mathrm{ccc}}(v_0,v_1),\varphi_{\mathrm{Card}}(v_0),\varphi_{\mathrm{cf}}(v_0,v_1)\in\mathrm{Fml}_S(\mathcal L_\in)$ 分别编码“$v_1$ 是 $v_0$ 上的 c.c.c. 偏序”“$v_0$ 是基数”和“$v_1=\operatorname{cf}(v_0)$”；其自由变元依次包含于 $\{v_0,v_1\}$、$\{v_0\}$、$\{v_0,v_1\}$（see [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]], [[../batch07/58-df-free-variable.md]]）。
$\mathrm{Fml}_S^{(n)}(\mathcal L_\in)$ is the set of $n$-variable formulas of set theory (see [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]]).

$\ulcorner\theta_{\mathrm{fn}}\urcorner,\ulcorner\theta_\in\urcorner,\ulcorner\theta_{\leq}\urcorner\in\mathrm{Fml}_S(\Sigma_\in)$ are their set codes under the syntax constructors of [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]].
$\ulcorner\theta_{\mathrm{ccc}}\urcorner\in\mathrm{Fml}_S(\Sigma_\in)$ is its fixed set code under [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]].

$\mathrm{Fml}_S(\Sigma)$ (set of formulas, see [[58-df-formula]]), $\mathrm{FV}_{\Sigma}$ (free-variable set, see [[58-df-free-variable]]), $\mathrm{Model}_S$ (model-of-a-theory predicate, see [[58-df-model]]), and $\mathrm{ZfcModel10OmittedType}_S$ (see [[58-df-zfc-model10-omitted-type]])
$\mathrm{Fml}_S(\Sigma)\in V$（签名 $\Sigma$ 上的公式集，见 [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]]）
$\varphi\in\mathrm{Fml}_S(\mathcal L_\in)$ (集合论语言公式码, see [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]])
$\Sigma_{\in}$ is the first-order signature of set theory, with no nonlogical function or constant symbols and with $\in$ as its sole binary relation symbol (see [[58-df-formula]])
$v_0,v_1,\ldots$ 为 [[../batch17/58-df-formula.md]] 的不同变量码；$\vec v_n=\{\langle i,v_i\rangle:i\in n\}$，$R(\vec v_n)$ 表示该文件的 $n$ 元原子公式构造子。
